source_text: Fidelibus manna dulce permanet. Gustate et videte quoniam suavis est Dominus — Iesus Christus. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: To-faithful manna sweet remains. Taste and see that sweet is Lord — Jesus Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: To the faithful the manna stays sweet. [[Taste and see that the Lord is sweet >> Bible:Psalm 34:8]] — Jesus Christ our Savior. Amen.
